Play rule & calculation

Fictional value = full-window play value × server quota usage. This is an arbitrary game rule, not API cost, real savings or value provided by OpenAI. The index divides this value by the subscription charge allocated to the entire quota window. Billing boundaries and currency must match. Changing the rule never changes your tier. Actual API cost is not measured.

This window utilization: %1$s%%

Game rules v1. Iron 0–<10, Bronze 10–<20, Silver 20–<30, Gold 30–<45, Platinum 45–<60, Emerald 60–<75, Diamond 75–<85, Master 85–<92, Grandmaster 92–<97, Challenger 97–100. Up to four comparable completed weekly windows, with observations near both boundaries and no gaps/corrections. Missing records are not zero. Tier is utilization, not skill or productivity.
Coach says
Why this assessment?

Local rules and written phrases, not live AI advice. Tier, current usage, reset time and measurement quality select the situation. The daily variant is stable across refreshes. No projects, work quality or spending benefits are inferred.
